title: The Body's Tiny Defense Team
intro: This quiz follows Zara and Eli as they learn how the immune system protects the body from cold viruses and other germs.

questions.explanation: The common cold is caused by tiny germs called viruses.

choices: Through droplets from coughs and sneezes or from contaminated hands
questions.explanation: Cold viruses can spread through droplets from coughs and sneezes or from contaminated hands.

questions.prompt: Which are part of the body's first line of defense?
choices: Mucus, cilia, tears, saliva, and skin
questions.explanation: Mucus, cilia, tears, saliva, and skin are part of the body's first line of defense.

questions.prompt: What do neutrophils and macrophages do?
choices: Find, surround, and help destroy invading germs
questions.explanation: Neutrophils and macrophages find, surround, and help destroy invading germs.

questions.prompt: Why might a person sneeze, make extra mucus, or develop a mild fever during a cold?
choices: These are signs that the immune system is fighting the germs
The body is becoming weaker forever
questions.explanation: Sneezing, extra mucus, or a mild fever are signs that the immune system is fighting the germs.
